summary: Project staged sidebar edits into optimistic rows without changing the observed base

replay.detail: Unknown delivery and acknowledgement retain the staged overlay; exact request replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: Reuses v2 projected rows and existing operations; no wire or journal format change.

compatibility.detail: Unwired Edits::project overlays only the current staged step. Folder-first membership staging still requires a fresh base. Final batch positions determine deletion lifts, independent of operation order; creation never clears a same-batch tombstone. Genuinely missing ancestors resolve to root. SidebarTree retains old tombstone IDs but not their ancestry: references requiring that unavailable ancestry conservatively keep the observed rows rather than guessing an optimistic location. Refusal restores observed rows; observation stops applying completed operations before completion persistence. Ordering and ancestry validation reuse the projection; names remain host decoration.

recovery.detail: Refused intent remains available for retry; partial failure preserves observed folder success. Rust tests are written but not run during the host disk hold.
